blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The instruction documents many important behaviors, including recursive selector fallback, canonical archive details, metrics semantics, reproducibility across mtimes/locales, and performance, but tests/test_outputs.py covers only four small scenarios and does not test most of them.

valid_failure_modes: tests/test.sh depends on apt-get and downloading uv from astral.sh at verification time, so a capable solution can fail because of external network or package-service availability rather than task difficulty.
advice: informative_test_structure: The tests are densely minified into single-line function bodies with almost no comments or section organization, making them difficult to read and maintain.

pinned_dependencies: The Dockerfile uses the floating patch-level tag python:3.13-slim-bookworm rather than a digest or fully pinned image; external test tooling is versioned more precisely but the environment dependency is not fully pinned.
